questions.q_en: One evening, Divya started to walk towards the sun. After walking a while, she turned to her right and walked for some distance and again turned right. After walking a while she again turned right. Which direction is she facing finally?
questions.solution_en:
One evening, Divya started to walk towards the sun.

In the evening the sun is in the west direction.

After walking a while, she turned to her right and again turned right.

After walking a while she again turned right.

So, she is facing the south direction.
